claim_boundary: WGSRPD3 is coarse and the finite 369-unit support imposes a formal ceiling; this sensitivity assesses whether that ceiling explains the reported near-zero specialization gradient.
interpretation: The near-zero family-breadth association with proportional expansion persists after excluding broad native envelopes and after rank adjustment for native breadth. Absolute added units show only a weak marginal family-breadth association that disappears after controlling starting resource breadth.
